title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
executive_summary: This change fixes a horn state display bug on the brake/horn interface screen that only affects SR-FLRT3-DMU trains - when you press the Horn key, the screen doesn't update to show the horn is active, even though the same functionality works correctly on other screens and in SR-KSS_EMU trains. The issue lives in the Brake System Interface component and touches the Crew Display HMI and Locomotive Interface Gateway indirectly. You should run L2R05:TC1 and L2R01:TC1 first as P0 priority tests since they directly test the reported bug with the horn key press on the brake/horn interface screen, then follow up with the five P1 tests covering horn key behavior across different control types and screen states. There's a gap though - the three evidence files (test artifacts.zip, dev_logs.log, Logs.zip) haven't been explicitly linked to the requirements L2R01 and L2R05, so make sure those attachments actually support what we're testing.

ecr_overview.title: Port Build 7 ECR -2 to Build 8: Flrt3: Horn state doesn't change on brake/horn interface screen
ecr_overview.description:
When the Horn key is pressed on the "brake/horn interface" screen, Ob doesn't update the Horn state field to Active, and it continues to show Inactive on the screen.

This is working fine on "EBI Slot 6 - EBI Onboard Diagnostics" and "System Test - Brakes" Screen.

This issue is only observed for SR-FLRT3-DMU. For SR-KSS_EMU, Ob is working correctly.

change_classification.summary: The Horn state field on the brake/horn interface screen fails to update to Active when the Horn key is pressed for SR-FLRT3-DMU vehicles, while remaining Inactive despite the action. This fix ports the corrected behavior from Build 7 to Build 8, affecting UI state management in the braking interface module.

The issue lives in the Brake System Interface component and touches the Crew Display HMI and Locomotive Interface Gateway indirectly. You should run L2R05:TC1 and L2R01:TC1 first as P0 priority tests since they directly test the reported bug with the horn key press on the brake/horn interface screen, then follow up with the five P1 tests covering horn key behavior across different control types and screen states. There's a gap though - the three evidence files (test artifacts.zip, dev_logs.log, Logs.zip) haven't been explicitly linked to the requirements L2R01 and L2R05, so make sure those attachments actually support what we're testing.

sections.title: ECR Overview
sections.body:
When the Horn key is pressed on the "brake/horn interface" screen, Ob doesn't update the Horn state field to Active, and it continues to show Inactive on the screen.

This issue is only observed for SR-FLRT3-DMU. For SR-KSS_EMU, Ob is working correctly.
